notes: Roach Modbus Tool v1.2.0 - Licensing now uses Polar. One license key works on up to 3 computers at a time and does not expire. To move a license, choose Help → Remove License on the old computer, or remove the device in the Polar customer portal. License keys from the previous store (Lemon Squeezy) are no longer accepted.
